mutants.name: m01_fund_before_margin.py
mutants.description: the defaulter's default fund is used before its initial margin (layer order swapped).

mutants.name: m02_capital_before_fund.py
mutants.description: the CCP capital is used before the defaulter's default fund (layer order swapped).

mutants.name: m03_survivors_by_count.py
mutants.description: surviving members pay equal shares by count, not pro rata to their default funds.

mutants.name: m04_leftover_to_last_survivor.py
mutants.description: the leftover cents go to the last surviving member instead of the first.

mutants.name: m05_no_remainder_rule.py
mutants.description: survivor shares are truncated and the leftover cents are never paid, so the invariant breaks.

mutants.name: m06_uncovered_dropped.py
mutants.description: the uncovered loss above the survivors' total is dropped instead of reported.

mutants.name: m07_floor_index.py
mutants.description: the sizing index is the floor of target times count over 10000, not its ceiling.

mutants.name: m08_strict_cover.py
mutants.description: the cover counts only losses strictly below the margin, so a loss equal to the margin is not covered.

mutants.name: m09_largest_loss_always.py
mutants.description: the margin for every target is the largest loss, with no quantile at all.

mutants.name: m10_seed0_hardcoded.py
mutants.description: the sizing returns the seed-0 margin for 9500 bps (73529 cents) for every instance and target.

mutants.name: n1_defaulter_checked_in_margins_only.py
mutants.description: the defaulter is checked against the margin dictionary only, so a defaulter present in the margins but absent from the default funds is accepted (the member ids are the keys of default_fund_cents).

mutants.name: n2_cover_skips_negative_loss_check.py
mutants.description: cover_bps does not refuse a negative loss; only margin_for_cover checks the sign of the losses.

mutants.name: n3_remainder_to_highest_id_first.py
mutants.description: the leftover cents go to the surviving members in descending id order, so the highest id is paid first.

mutants.name: n4_margin_layer_pools_all_margins.py
mutants.description: the defaulter's margin layer uses the sum of every member's initial margin instead of the defaulter's own.

mutants.name: r12a_survivor_share_rounded_up.py
mutants.description: each survivor's pro rata share is rounded up to a whole cent (a ceiling), not floored, so the shares can exceed the residual.

mutants.name: r12b_sizing_index_float.py
mutants.description: the sizing index is computed in floats as target / 10000 * count and rounded up, not in integers as the page requires.

mutants.name: r12c_only_one_leftover_cent.py
mutants.description: the leftover cents are paid one cent only, to the first survivor with a positive fund, so a residual with two or more leftover cents leaves cents unpaid.

mutants.name: r12d_uncovered_added_to_first_survivor.py
mutants.description: the uncovered loss is added to the first survivor's payment, so the survivors pay more than their whole default funds.

mutants.name: r13a_leftover_only_to_positive_share.py
mutants.description: the leftover cents go only to survivors whose computed share is already positive, so a residual smaller than the survivor count leaves cents unpaid.

mutants.name: r13b_uncovered_negative_below_pool.py
mutants.description: the uncovered loss is set to the residual less the survivors' pool in both branches, so it is negative when the residual is below the pool.

mutants.name: r13c_cover_skips_the_last_scenario.py
mutants.description: the cover loop stops one scenario early (it reads the losses without the last one) but still divides by the full count of scenarios.

mutants.name: r13d_fund_layer_capped_at_survivor_pool.py
mutants.description: the defaulter's default fund is capped at the surviving members' pool, so the fund layer can pay less than the defaulter's whole contribution when the pool is smaller.

mutants.name: r14a_defaulter_id_range_fixed_at_four_members.py
mutants.description: the defaulter id is checked against a fixed range of 1 to 4, as if there were four members, so a valid defaulter in a five- or six-member set is refused.

mutants.name: r14b_survivors_in_dictionary_order.py
mutants.description: the survivors are taken in the order the default-fund dictionary lists them, not in ascending id order, so the leftover cent goes to whichever surviving member the dictionary lists first.

mutants.name: r14c_negative_fund_check_skips_survivors.py
mutants.description: a negative default fund for a surviving member is accepted, because the non-negative check is applied to the defaulter's fund only, so a negative share can follow.

mutants.name: r14d_warns_on_uncovered_loss.py
mutants.description: a warning is issued when a loss is uncovered, which is a valid output, so the module warns on a valid input and the suite run with warnings as errors fails.

mutants.name: r15a_margin_strict_count_position.py
mutants.description: margin_for_cover counts the losses strictly below each loss, so it returns the loss one place above the k-th smallest at every target.

mutants.name: r15b_default_fund_capped_at_full_loss.py
mutants.description: the defaulter's default fund is capped at the full loss, not at what the margin left of the loss, so the fund and the margin can pay the same cent twice.

mutants.name: r15d_leftover_by_largest_remainder.py
mutants.description: the leftover cents go to the survivors with the largest fractional remainders (the largest-remainder method), not to the first survivors in ascending id order.

mutants.name: r15e_cover_divides_by_count_minus_one.py
mutants.description: cover_bps divides by one fewer than the number of scenarios (a sample-size slip), so every cover is overstated.

mutants.name: r16a_target_message_omits_target_bps.py
mutants.description: the target refusal says the target is out of range but does not name target_bps, so the learner cannot see which input failed.

mutants.name: r16b_defaulter_margin_read_at_zero_based_index.py
mutants.description: the defaulter's initial margin is read at key defaulter_id - 1, a zero-based position applied to the one-based member ids.

mutants.name: r16c_default_fund_ignores_the_margin_already_paid.py
mutants.description: the defaulter's default fund is capped at the full loss instead of at the loss the margin left, so the fund can pay what the margin already paid.

mutants.name: r16d_loss_refusal_message_omits_loss_cents.py
mutants.description: the negative-loss refusal in waterfall words the message without naming loss_cents, so the learner cannot tell which input was negative.

mutants.name: r16e_cover_sorts_the_callers_list_in_place.py
mutants.description: cover_bps sorts the caller's scenario list in place before counting, so the list the caller passed is reordered.

mutants.name: r17a_capital_layer_ignores_margin_paid.py
mutants.description: the CCP capital is sized on the loss less the default fund only, so the margin's cents are paid again by the capital.

mutants.name: r17b_sizing_drops_the_last_loss.py
mutants.description: the sizing reads the k-th smallest of the losses without the last scenario, so the largest scenario is never counted.

mutants.name: r17c_margin_layer_reads_the_fund_table.py
mutants.description: the defaulter's margin layer reads the default-fund table, a dictionary mix-up, so the margin is taken from the fund.

mutants.name: r17d_zero_margin_covers_nothing.py
mutants.description: a margin of zero is read as no margin, so cover_bps returns zero even when zero losses are at the margin.

mutants.name: r17e_uncovered_subtracts_the_capital_again.py
mutants.description: the uncovered loss subtracts the CCP capital a second time, so an uncovered loss is understated.

mutants.name: r18a_full_cover_margin_is_last_loss_given.py
mutants.description: the margin for a 10000 bps target is the last loss in the list the caller passed, not the largest loss.

mutants.name: r18b_capital_paid_after_survivors.py
mutants.description: the CCP capital is used after the surviving members pay, so the survivors pay the residual before the capital covers it.

mutants.name: r18c_uncovered_reports_the_residual.py
mutants.description: when the residual is at or above the survivors' total, the uncovered loss is reported as the whole residual, not the excess above the total.

mutants.name: r18d_waterfall_result_not_frozen.py
mutants.description: Waterfall is an ordinary (mutable) dataclass, not the frozen dataclass the page names, so its fields can be reassigned.

mutants.name: r19a_leftover_to_every_positive_survivor.py
mutants.description: the leftover cents are given one each to every survivor with a positive fund, not only to as many survivors as there are leftover cents.

mutants.name: r19b_share_denominator_includes_defaulter_fund.py
mutants.description: the pro rata share divides by the survivors' pool plus the defaulter's own default fund, so the shares are cut too small.

mutants.name: r19c_negative_check_looks_at_first_loss_only.py
mutants.description: the negative-loss check looks only at the first scenario, so a negative loss later in the list is accepted.

mutants.name: r19d_sizing_memo_keyed_by_target_only.py
mutants.description: margin_for_cover caches its answer by target alone, so a second case with the same target gets the first case's margin.

mutants.name: r19e_index_floor_plus_one.py
mutants.description: the sizing index is the floor of target times count over 10000, plus one, so an exact position is taken one loss too high.

mutants.name: r3a_dedupe_before_sizing.py
mutants.description: the sizing sorts the distinct losses only, so a repeated loss counts once in the order statistic.

mutants.name: r3b_cover_counts_distinct_losses.py
mutants.description: the cover counts each distinct loss once, not each of the S scenarios, so a repeated loss is lost.

mutants.name: r3c_defaulter_checked_upper_bound_only.py
mutants.description: the defaulter id is refused only when it exceeds the number of members, so id 0 is accepted.

mutants.name: r3d_negative_check_defaulter_only.py
mutants.description: a negative initial margin or default fund is refused only for the defaulter, not for every member.

mutants.name: r3e_sizing_counts_distinct_losses.py
mutants.description: the sizing counts the distinct losses for S and sorts only the distinct losses, so k uses the distinct count.

mutants.name: r3f_defaulter_upper_bound_from_max_id.py
mutants.description: the defaulter id is refused only when it exceeds the largest member id, so id 0 is accepted.

mutants.name: r4a_leftover_in_mapping_order.py
mutants.description: the leftover cents go in the order of the default-fund dictionary, not in ascending id order.

mutants.name: r4b_sizing_index_round_half_up.py
mutants.description: the sizing index is round-half-up of target times count over 10000, not its ceiling.

mutants.name: r4c_share_integer_division_first.py
mutants.description: each survivor's share is (residual // pool) times its fund, so the pro rata share is truncated first.

mutants.name: r4d_zero_loss_refused.py
mutants.description: a loss of zero cents is refused as if it were not a scenario, so the zero-loss boundary is rejected.

mutants.name: r4e_cover_round_half_up.py
mutants.description: the cover is rounded half up to the nearest basis point instead of floored.

mutants.name: r4f_sizing_sorts_caller_list_in_place.py
mutants.description: margin_for_cover sorts the caller's list in place before indexing it.

mutants.name: r4g_debug_print_on_defaulter_refusal.py
mutants.description: a debug print is left in the defaulter-not-a-member refusal, so a refused input prints before it raises.

mutants.name: r4h_debug_print_on_uncovered_loss.py
mutants.description: a debug print is left in the uncovered-loss branch, so a valid call with an uncovered loss prints.

mutants.name: r5a_leftover_rotates_from_the_defaulter.py
mutants.description: the leftover cents start at the member after the defaulter and wrap around, not at the lowest id.

mutants.name: r5b_sizing_clamps_target_above_10000.py
mutants.description: a target above 10000 bps is clamped to full cover instead of refused with ValueError.

mutants.name: r5c_sizing_drops_zero_losses_before_counting.py
mutants.description: scenarios with a zero loss are dropped before the sizing, so the count S excludes them.

mutants.name: r5d_cover_denominator_excludes_zero_losses.py
mutants.description: the cover divides by the number of positive losses, so zero-loss scenarios leave the denominator.

mutants.name: r5e_refuses_a_zero_default_fund.py
mutants.description: a default fund of zero is refused as invalid, although the page lets a survivor with DF_i = 0 pay zero.

mutants.name: r5f_sizing_index_uses_count_minus_one.py
mutants.description: the sizing index uses S - 1 scenarios, one fewer than the S scenarios the page counts.

mutants.name: s01_leftover_to_largest_fund_first.py
mutants.description: the leftover cents go to the largest default funds first (ties by id), not to the first survivors in ascending id order.

mutants.name: s02_shares_weighted_by_margins.py
mutants.description: the residual is shared in proportion to the survivors' initial margins, not their default funds.

mutants.name: s03_zero_fund_survivor_left_out.py
mutants.description: survivors with a zero default fund are left out of survivor_cents instead of being listed with zero.

mutants.name: s04_empty_scenario_message_reworded.py
mutants.description: margin_for_cover refuses an empty scenario set with a message that does not say at least one scenario is needed.

mutants.name: s05_sizing_index_rounds_to_nearest.py
mutants.description: the sizing index rounds the exact position to the nearest whole scenario instead of rounding it up.

mutants.name: t8a_shares_rounded_half_up.py
mutants.description: each survivor share is rounded half up to the nearest cent, not floored, so the shares can add to more than the residual.

mutants.name: t8b_cover_rounded_up.py
mutants.description: the cover is rounded up to the next basis point (a ceiling), not floored.

mutants.name: t8c_sizing_sorts_descending.py
mutants.description: the sizing sorts the losses in descending order and then takes the k-th entry, so it returns the k-th largest loss.

mutants.name: t8d_capital_layer_skips_default_fund.py
mutants.description: the CCP capital layer is charged on the loss after the margin only, so the default fund is paid twice.

mutants.name: t8e_waterfall_pops_defaulter_from_argument.py
mutants.description: the waterfall removes the defaulter from the caller's default_fund_cents dictionary before it shares the residual.

mutants.name: v9a_margin_for_cover_empty_returns_zero.py
mutants.description: margin_for_cover returns 0 for an empty scenario list instead of refusing it with ValueError.

mutants.name: v9b_waterfall_always_prorates_the_residual.py
mutants.description: waterfall drops the branch for a residual at or above the pool, so survivors pay more than their whole default fund.

mutants.name: v9c_cover_bps_rounds_to_nearest.py
mutants.description: cover_bps rounds the cover to the nearest basis point instead of flooring it.

mutants.name: v9d_margin_for_cover_scan_is_strict.py
mutants.description: margin_for_cover scans the distinct losses and compares the cover strictly above the target, so a cover that equals the target is never accepted.

mutants.name: v9e_waterfall_refuses_a_zero_defaulter_margin.py
mutants.description: waterfall refuses a defaulter whose initial margin is zero, which the page allows.

mutants.name: vc01_cover_rounded.py
mutants.description: the cover is rounded to the nearest basis point instead of floored.

mutants.name: vc02_zero_based_index.py
mutants.description: the sizing reads the zero-based position k instead of the k-th smallest loss (k - 1).

mutants.name: vc03_sizing_unsorted.py
mutants.description: the sizing picks the k-th loss as given, without sorting the scenarios first.

mutants.name: vc04_cover_no_refusal.py
mutants.description: cover_bps accepts a negative loss without raising, so the named refusal is missing.

mutants.name: vc05_target_zero_allowed.py
mutants.description: the target range check starts at 0, so a target of 0 bps is accepted and silently sized.

mutants.name: vc06_fund_without_min.py
mutants.description: the default fund pays its full contribution even when the loss is smaller, so layers overpay.

mutants.name: vc07_leftover_to_zero_fund.py
mutants.description: the leftover cent goes to a survivor with a zero default fund, skipping the DF > 0 rule.

mutants.name: vc08_index_plus_one.py
mutants.description: the sizing index is floor(target times count / 10000) plus one, an off-by-one at exact positions.

mutants.name: vc09_capital_ignored.py
mutants.description: the CCP capital is left out of the waterfall, so the survivors pay the capital's share.

mutants.name: vc10_float_arithmetic.py
mutants.description: integer arithmetic replaced by float division (int of a float share, math.ceil of a float index), exact on small cents but not above 2**53.

mutants.name: vc12_pool_counts_the_defaulter_fund.py
mutants.description: the survivors' pool includes the defaulter's own default fund, so shares are cut by it.

mutants.name: vc13_cover_of_no_scenarios_is_zero.py
mutants.description: cover_bps returns 0 for an empty scenario set instead of refusing it with ValueError.

mutants.name: vc14_target_ten_thousand_refused.py
mutants.description: the target range check uses 9999 as its upper limit, so a full target of 10000 bps is refused.

mutants.name: vc15_negative_capital_accepted.py
mutants.description: a negative CCP capital is not checked, so it is accepted and reduces the layers.

mutants.name: x10a_pool_uses_survivor_margins.py
mutants.description: the survivors' pool is summed from their initial margins instead of their default funds.

mutants.name: x10b_cover_counts_strictly_below.py
mutants.description: cover_bps counts only losses strictly below the margin, so a loss equal to the margin is not covered.

mutants.name: x10c_survivors_include_the_defaulter.py
mutants.description: the survivors are every member, so the defaulter is listed in survivor_cents and its default fund joins the pool.

mutants.name: x10d_uncovered_ignores_the_capital.py
mutants.description: the uncovered loss is the loss less the margin, fund and survivors' pool, so the CCP capital is left out of the uncovered amount.

mutants.name: y11a_residual_forgets_the_capital.py
mutants.description: the residual subtracts the margin and the default fund but not the CCP capital, so the capital is paid twice.

mutants.name: y11b_cover_divides_the_count_before_multiplying.py
mutants.description: the cover divides the count by S before multiplying by 10000, so it is zero unless every scenario is covered.

mutants.name: y11c_survivors_prorated_even_past_the_pool.py
mutants.description: when the residual reaches the surviving pool, the survivors are still charged pro rata to the residual, so no survivor pays its whole default fund and no uncovered loss is reported.

mutants.name: y11d_unknown_defaulter_treated_as_zero_exposure.py
mutants.description: a defaulter id that is not a member is treated as holding zero margin and zero fund instead of raising ValueError.
